integrity: Finite enumeration checks are not substitutes for the all-order proof. All claims have exact definitions and analytic arguments; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only first edge-Walsh band on uniformly distributed connected labelled unicyclic graphs, with a mandatory one-dimensional deterministic dependence. A historical equivalent in random-graph covariance literature cannot be ruled out under bounded searching.
title: Exact centered Walsh stability for uniform labelled unicyclic graphs
